{{Top|leg}}
'''Syp wood''' grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossel II]]. [[Free-trader]]s would often land on the planet to acquire the wood; however the native [[Ossan]]s refused to take any type of payment or barter for the wood, preferring to indenture themselves to the crew of the vessel for a period of service.
